commands.tcl: set ps7 [get_cells -hierarchical -filter {REF_NAME == PS7}]; puts "PS7_COUNT=[llength $ps7]"; if {[llength $ps7] != 1} {error "STOP: PS7 count not one"}; foreach c $ps7 {puts "PS7=$c|REF=[get_property REF_NAME $c]|LOC=[get_property LOC $c]"; set pins [get_pins -of_objects $c]; puts "PS7_PIN_COUNT=[llength $pins]"; if {[llength $pins] > 1024} {error "STOP: PS7 pin budget exceeded"}; foreach p $pins {set rpn [get_property REF_PIN_NAME $p]; if {[string match *HP0* $rpn]} {puts "HP0PIN=[get_property NAME $p]|$rpn|[get_property DIRECTION $p]"}}}
commands.output:
PS7_COUNT=1
PS7=s2b_inference_i/ps7/inst/PS7_i|REF=PS7|LOC=PS7_X0Y0
PS7_PIN_COUNT=3305
STOP: PS7 pin budget exceeded

disposition: No HP0 pins were iterated after the 1024-object cap was exceeded; the owned Vivado session was closed. A separate run will use an early REF_PIN_NAME filter with a bounded HP0-only result set.
